QUOTE: "**Default build:** `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` is off (`mbedtls_config.h:208`)."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY is off by default in mbedtls_config.h and that enabling it is what makes the allocator swappable. That covers both the gate and the shipped-config default, though "off" is not worded as "commented out".
